tmp:1329: ziz — the Ziz Sadai, the mythical giant bird of Psalms 50:11 read by Rav Ashi as symbolizing the Lower Unification (yichuda tata'ah) paired with the Supernal Unification
tmp:1332: shoresh ha-gevurot — the kabbalistic 'root of the Gevurot' (severities), identified with the joy-bringing wine that Yaakov drew down to sweeten judgment ('and he brought him wine and he drank')
tmp:1333: bitul kol hargeshotav ve-chomriyutav — the state of nullifying all one's senses and physicality, required (as with Moshe's 'erase me') so that praise even from a great king breeds no self-aggrandizement
tmp:1334: attaining shlemut ha-da'at — the capacity to reach perfected/complete da'at (expanded consciousness), via the three things that broaden a man's mind: a fitting wife (matter), dwelling (yirah), and vessels (Berakhot 57b)
tmp:1335: the fitness to build a house — being permitted to engage in building without harm ('whoever builds becomes impoverished,' Sotah 11a) because one builds with wisdom, per 'through wisdom a house is built' (Prov 24:3)
tmp:1336: the ability to speak words in holiness and purity — speech empowered by peace (shalom) that joins the opposites Chasadim (Havayah) and Gevurot (Elokim)
tmp:1337: the capacity to understand and grasp the tzaddik's speech — attained only after properly rectifying the sign of the holy covenant (brit), since Yesod ascends to Abba/Imma (Chokhmah-Binah, Yod-Heh mochin)
tmp:1339: simchat ha-mitzvot — the joy in performing the commandments, through which (with yirah) one can discern whether a heavenly decree has been sealed (Rabbah bar bar Chana's ship-and-arrow allegory)
tmp:1340: the action of pacing to and fro within one's house — Elisha's walking 'once this way and once that way' (II Kings 4:35), likened to the lung's wings fanning the heart, an act with power to revive the dead
tmp:1341: yakhol lehachayot metim — the power to resurrect/revive the dead, achieved through pacing back and forth like Elisha reviving the Shunamite's son (II Kings 4)
tmp:1342: the state of the field-master's eyes shining and watching — the tzaddik's illuminated vision when souls do God's will, the aspect of 'Sedeh Tzofim,' the field of watchers/seers (Numbers 23:14)
tmp:1344: the qualification to pray before the amud — fitness to serve as sheliach tzibbur (prayer leader), earned by gathering the good points in every Jew, even Jewish sinners, into melodies
tmp:1345: tasting sweetness in prayer — the capacity to sense sweetness in the words of tefillah, the aspect of 'all my bones shall say' (Ps 35:10), lost by one who blemishes the brit (whose prayer the 'dog' devours)
tmp:1346: one who enters into the joy — the person who, entering the joy of the mitzvot, can thereby discern whether a decree is before or after sealing and on which limb of the 'stature' it falls
tmp:1347: chokhmah in its proper standing and completeness — wisdom whole and intact, the state of 'one against two,' enabling one to wage God's wars ('wisdom is better than weapons of war,' Eccl 9:18)
tmp:1348: waging the wars of Hashem — the capacity to fight God's battles through perfected wisdom rather than weapons, subduing adversaries who pursue the weak of Israel
tmp:1349: teaching students without harming them — the ability to transmit one's wisdom safely to disciples, achieved by measuring out one's words with mishpat ('sustains his words with judgment')
tmp:1350: the state of having bitachon and giving tzedakah — trust in God ('trust in Hashem and do good,' Ps 37:3) that enables proper charity, which in turn forms perfected speech
tmp:1351: turning chirping-sounds into speech — the power to transform inarticulate voice/chirps (tziftzufim) into articulate holy words, effected through tzedakah born of bitachon ('by your mouth — this is charity')
tmp:1353: receiving the holiness of Yom Tov — the capacity to sense festival sanctity, gained through attachment to the tzaddik who is himself the aspect of the festival's holiness
tmp:1354: seeing one's own lowliness (leading to complete teshuvah) — the Shabbat-enabled vision of one's shiflut, since ShaBaT = shin (three colors of the eye) + bat (pupil), 'See that God has given you the Shabbat'
tmp:1355: pouring out one's heart like water before Hashem — the nighttime hitbodedut of conversing with one's heart and searching one's spirit ('I recall my melody at night... my spirit searches,' Ps 77)
tmp:1356: the Torah's receiving from Chokhmah Ila'ah — Torah's capacity to draw from Supernal Wisdom ('Torah issues from Chokhmah Ila'ah'), possible only when Torah is complete via the Oral Torah
tmp:1357: drawing down the shefa — the capacity to bring down divine abundance, tied to revealing God's Kingship whereby the kelipot are subdued beneath the Shekhinah
tmp:1358: the ability to draw near and rebuke those needing rebuke — fitness to admonish and bring people close, tied to studying Torah aloud with the mouth (calling the Life of life by name)
tmp:1359: speaking words in holiness — the power to utter holy speech through shalom, which joins the opposites Chasadim and Gevurot, the aspect of Yosef and mesirat nefesh for kiddush Hashem
tmp:1360: bringing our mishpat to light — the power, via emunat chakhamim (faith in the Sages, 'do not deviate right or left'), to issue judgment along the central pillar, the balanced middle path
tmp:1361: drawing down the holiness of Eretz Yisrael in exile — the capacity to reveal the Land of Israel's kedushah even under the Sitra Achra in bitter galut ('even also this, in the land of their enemies,' Lev 26:41)
tmp:1362: earning money legitimately — the capacity to gain wealth only by traversing and breaking the 140 'voices' of the craving for money, since abundance flows from truth
tmp:1363: receiving ruach nevuah / ruach ha-kodesh — the capacity to receive the spirit of prophecy/holy spirit, via the musician's hand separating the good spirit from the melancholy evil spirit (as with Elisha's minstrel)
tmp:1365: being included in the air of Eretz Yisrael — incorporation into the avira de-Eretz Yisrael, the holy sinless breath (like the breath of schoolchildren) through which the patriarchs are revealed and judgment repelled
tmp:1366: subduing and casting down all the enemies — the overthrow of all opposing foes (as the 'great mountain' before Zerubavel), 'not by might nor by power but by My spirit' (Zech 4:6-7)
tmp:1368: Yam shel Shlomo — the molten Sea of Solomon in the Temple standing on twelve oxen, symbol of Malkhut/the God-fearing woman resting on the twelve tribes of God (Zohar Vayechi 241)
tmp:1370: yamim — 'days' as a symbol for the middot (divine attributes/measures), the vessels bounding the life-force, per 'the measure of my days, what it is' (Ps 39:5)
tmp:1371: shefa ruchaniyut — spiritual abundance, the 'right hand' of the Torah ('length of days in her right hand,' Prov 3:16), flowing to the world that is entirely long, the upper worlds
tmp:1372: yemina — the kabbalistic Right side (Chesed), Aharon's side in the Korach dispute, unified with the left through hand-clapping
tmp:1376: ve-hatznea — 'and [walk] humbly' (Micah 6:8) read as the sefirah Yesod, the third sukkah-wall of 'even a handbreadth,' which 'reveals a tefach and conceals a tefach'
tmp:1378: tefach — the handbreadth measure: the sukkah's minimal third wall (Sukkah 6b) symbolizing Yesod, which 'reveals a handbreadth and conceals a handbreadth'
tmp:1379: melichut — saltiness, the quality that causes thirst, identified with yissurin/sufferings ('a covenant is said of salt and a covenant is said of sufferings,' Berakhot 5a)
tmp:1380: yissurin — sufferings/afflictions as a covenantal category likened to salt (Berakhot 5a), whose felt burning is the soul's thirst, cooled by Torah innovations
